title: would like (to) (I'd like a coffee / I'd like to ~)
goal: I'd like ~로 공손하게 주문·요청하고, Would you like ~?로 상대에게 권하거나 물어볼 수 있어요.

points.title: would like = want의 공손한 말
points.body: would like는 '~을 원해요, ~하고 싶어요'를 정중하게 말하는 표현이에요. 보통 줄여서 I'd like[아이드 라이크]라고 해요. 카페 주문, 면접, 가게에서 아주 많이 써요.

points.title: I'd like + 물건
points.body: 원하는 물건을 말할 때는 would like 뒤에 바로 명사를 써요. (I'd like a flat white, please.)

points.title: I'd like to + 동사원형
points.body: 하고 싶은 행동을 말할 때는 would like to + 동사원형이에요. (I'd like to open an account.) 주어가 she여도 likes가 아니라 like예요.

points.title: Would you like ~? = ~하실래요?
points.body: 상대에게 권할 때는 Would you like + 명사? / Would you like to + 동사원형?이에요. 대답은 Yes, please. / No, thank you.가 자연스러워요.

points.title: Do you like ~?와 달라요
points.body: Do you like coffee?는 '커피 좋아해요?'(취향), Would you like a coffee?는 '커피 드릴까요?'(권유)예요.

formula: 주어 + would like ('d like) + to + 동사원형
Would you like + 명사 ~? / Would you like to + 동사원형 ~?

mistakes.wrong: I'd like order a flat white.
mistakes.right: I'd like to order a flat white.
mistakes.why: 행동(order)이 오면 like 뒤에 to가 꼭 필요해요. I'd like to + 동사원형으로 기억하세요.

mistakes.wrong: Do you like a cup of tea? (차 한 잔 드릴까요?)
mistakes.right: Would you like a cup of tea?
mistakes.why: 권할 때는 Would you like ~?를 써요. Do you like ~?는 '좋아하냐'고 취향을 묻는 말이에요.
would 뒤에는 동사원형이 와서 주어가 she여도 like 그대로예요.

examples.en: I'd like a flat white, please.
I'd like to open a bank account.
Would you like to come to the beach with us?
We'd like a table for two, please.
She'd like to work on a farm.
I'd like to apply for the kitchen hand job.
A: Would you like a bag? B: No, thank you.
examples.ko: A: 봉투 필요하세요? B: 아니요, 괜찮아요.

quiz.sentence: I'd like ___ buy a ticket to Bondi.
quiz.why: 행동(buy)이 오면 would like to + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.ko: 그녀는 울루루에 가 보고 싶어 해요.

quiz.sentence: We'd like ___ table by the window.
quiz.why: 원하는 것이 물건(table)이면 would like 뒤에 바로 명사(a table)가 와요.

quiz.sentence: A: Would you like a drink? B: Yes, ___.
quiz.ko: A: 음료 드릴까요? B: 네, 주세요.
quiz.why: Would you like ~?에는 Yes, please.로 대답하는 게 자연스러워요.

choices: I'd like to a latte, please.
quiz.why: 물건을 원할 때는 I'd like + 명사예요. to는 필요 없어요.

quiz.answer: I'd like to speak to the manager.
choices: I'd like to speak to the manager.
I'd like speak to the manager.
I'd like speaking to the manager.
I'd likes to speak to the manager.
quiz.why: 하고 싶은 행동은 I'd like to + 동사원형이에요.

quiz.answer: Would you like to have dinner with me?
choices: Would you like to have dinner with me?
Would you like have dinner with me?
Do you would like to have dinner with me?
Would you likes to have dinner with me?
quiz.why: 행동을 권할 때는 Would you like to + 동사원형 ~?이에요.

quiz.answer: He'd like to live in Sydney.
choices: He'd like to live in Sydney.
He'd likes to live in Sydney.
He would to like live in Sydney.
quiz.why: 주어가 He여도 would like to + 동사원형이에요.

choices: Do you would like a receipt?

quiz.answer: They'd like to try kangaroo meat.
choices: They'd like to try kangaroo meat.
They'd liking to try kangaroo meat.
They'd likes to try kangaroo meat.

quiz.prompt: 카페 손님에게 '커피 드릴까요?'라고 권하는 맞는 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Would you like to a coffee?
quiz.why: 물건을 권할 때는 Would you like + 명사?예요.
